# FinTaxTech

> FinTaxTech is the trading name of Fintaxtech Ltd (SC807896), based in Dundee, Scotland. Official website: https://fintaxtech.co.uk/.

FinTaxTech (Fintaxtech Ltd, SC807896) designs and builds websites, mobile apps, branding, and AI automation tools for businesses and organisations worldwide. Work is delivered fully remotely, serving clients across the UK and internationally. All client work is done directly — no outsourcing.

## Company identity

- [About FinTaxTech](https://fintaxtech.co.uk/about/): company background and current services. Finance, accountancy and tax services are not currently available.
- [Fintaxtech Ltd at Companies House](https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/SC807896): Scottish registered company SC807896, incorporated 22 April 2024.
- [Selected work](https://fintaxtech.co.uk/selected-work/): project examples and attributed client feedback.

## Services

- [Website Design and Development](https://fintaxtech.co.uk/services/websites/): new websites and complete redesigns, built to explain what you do and bring in enquiries.
- [Mobile App Development](https://fintaxtech.co.uk/services/mobile-apps/): iOS and Android apps for customers or internal teams.
- [Branding and Graphic Design](https://fintaxtech.co.uk/services/branding/): logos and visual identity you can use across everything you publish.
- [AI Automation](https://fintaxtech.co.uk/services/ai-automation/): repetitive work supported by AI, structured workflows and human review. Suitability depends on source quality, system access, privacy and risk.

## Project boundaries and privacy

Client briefs and enquiry forms are noindex utility pages. An unlisted client URL is not access control. Questionnaire answers stay in browser memory; refreshing or closing clears them. PDFs are generated locally and shared only at the customer's initiative. Source documents are shared separately by arrangement.

Business accounts remain in the customer's name. Ownership of agreed final deliverables transfers after full payment, subject to licences and the written proposal. FinTaxTech retains its internal prompts, workflows and methods. See the [service terms](https://fintaxtech.co.uk/terms/).
